admin.title: Messages
admin.description: How long messages are kept, exports of a workspace's messages, and how fast people can send.

retention.title: Message retention
retention.description: Messages are kept forever unless you set a limit. With a limit, a daily job permanently deletes older messages in every workspace, with their attached files and the notifications about them.
retention.days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days from {min} to {max}.
retention.confirm_description: On its next daily run, Nexus will permanently delete every message older than {days} days, with its attached files, in every workspace. Deleted messages can't be recovered.

export.title: Export messages
export.description: Download one workspace's messages as a zip of JSON Lines files: channels, members, messages and thread replies, and the names and sizes of attachments (not the files). Each export can be downloaded for {hours} hours.
export.include_private: Include private channels and direct messages
export.include_private_help: Off exports public channels only. Private channels and direct messages are private conversations: include them only when you have a reason to, such as a legal request.
export.started: Export started. It appears below when it's ready.

rate_limits.title: Rate limits
rate_limits.description: How many of each request one person can make. Set them with the CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_* environment variables on the API.

rate_limits.agents_description: Limits on agents that reply when they're mentioned in a channel. Set them with the CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_AGENT_* environment variables, and the time limit with CHAT_AGENT_REPLY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, on the API. The time limit also applies to each turn in an agent chat.
rate_limits.agent_timeout: Time an agent may take to reply
